plugin.name: MultichannelAudio
plugin.title: Multichannel & Bitstream Audio
plugin.desc: Enables discrete multichannel LPCM (up to 7.1) and raw IEC 61937 HDMI bitstream passthrough (Dolby Digital Plus Atmos, Dolby TrueHD Atmos, DTS-HD MA / Auro-3D) for capable Squeezelite players, with automatic stereo downmix fallback for stereo players and mixed sync groups.
plugin.creator: gorman42
